scene.speaker: ingrid
scene.bubble: When the lights went out at the sports centre, everyone was doing something different. Let's find out what!

activities.title: Match the verb with its -ing form.

items.sentence: At six o'clock, Ingrid ___ swimming in the pool.
The boys ___ playing volleyball on the court.
What ___ you doing when the lights went out?
Maya ___ reading in the changing room.
We ___ not sleeping — we were training!

activities.title: Listen. What was everyone doing at 6 o'clock? Write a word in each gap.

data.script: Maya: So, Ingrid — at six o'clock the lights went out. What were you doing? … Ingrid: I was swimming in the pool. It was very dark and very funny! … Maya: And Oliver? … Ingrid: He was practising basketball on the court. He was carrying three balls! … Maya: What about Diego? … Ingrid: He was interviewing the trainer next to the gym. … Maya: And the little kids? … Ingrid: They were shouting happily in the dark — they thought it was a game! … Maya: And Kili? … Ingrid: Ha! He was sleeping on the roof. He didn't notice anything!

activities.title: Exam task · Choose the correct form.

data.instructions: Choose the correct past continuous form.

items.sentence: I ___ my homework when you phoned.
They ___ in the gym at five o'clock.
He slipped while he ___ to the pool.
The trainer blew the ___ to stop the game.

data.text: Alibi game: yesterday at 6 pm something happened at school. Student A is the detective: "What were you doing at six?" Student B invents an alibi. The detective asks 3 more questions to find contradictions!

homework.prompt: Write what 4 people in your family were doing yesterday at 8 pm: My dad was cooking dinner…
